reuse.why: It pulls the category loop of setNMonthAvgForAllCategories out into forEachMonthActionCategory, which keeps getMonthActionCategories and the income rule. Both the average actions and the new action use it, and it reads spending from the existing sum-amount sheet cells through setBudget.

duplication.why: Category selection and the income rule are shared, not copied. Only the small expense/income sign flip repeats the inline idiom setNMonthAvg uses.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with the same mutator(undoable(...)) wrapping.

scope.why: The change is limited to the new action, the small helper extraction it needs, its registration and its tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and consistent with its neighbours. setZero still runs its own copy of the selection loop instead of the new helper, but that was already the case before this change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through getMonthActionCategories (via the extracted forEachMonthActionCategory), setBudget and getSheetValue.

disguised_duplication.where: The loop is extracted and shared, not copied.
